messages:
Nia Park: Quick copy review — the 'Pause rollout' confirmation currently reads: "Are you sure you want to pause the rollout? This action can be undone." Users are confused whether pausing disables traffic or just stops increases.
Tomás Rivera: Good catch. We should make the consequence explicit and offer a clear primary action and a secondary path to documentation.
Lena Volkova: Proposed title: "Pause rollout?" Body: "Pausing will stop increasing traffic to the new model and keep the current traffic split unchanged. Traffic already routed to the new model will continue." Primary CTA: "Pause rollout" Secondary CTA: "View rollout docs"
Nia Park: Love the clarity. Two small wording tweaks: say "stop increasing traffic" -> "halt traffic increases" (shorter) and change "will continue" -> "will remain routed" for precision.
Tomás Rivera: Accessibility: confirm the primary CTA reads as a button and secondary is a link with descriptive text. Add aria-describedby referencing the detail paragraph. Also avoid sole use of color to indicate danger; include an icon and screen-reader text.
Lena Volkova: Also include a one-line recovery hint under the CTAs: "You can resume and adjust rollout weights later." Keep it lighter font.
Nia Park: Localization keys suggestion: `confirm.rollout.pause.title`, `.body`, `.cta_pause`, `.link_docs`, `.hint_recovery`. Draft final copy for translation file: Title: "Pause rollout?" Body: "Pausing will halt traffic increases for the new model. Traffic already routed to the new model will remain routed." CTA: "Pause rollout" Link: "View rollout docs" Hint: "You can resume and adjust rollout weights later."
design-bot: Accessibility lint: ensure modal has role="dialog" and the danger button includes aria-label="Pause rollout for <model-name>". Avoid ambiguous link text.
Tomás Rivera: I'll update the modal component to include the icon+sr-only and wire ARIA attributes. I'll also add a tiny telemetry event `rollout.pause.confirmed`.
Lena Volkova: LGTM from content. Nia, will you sign off on tone?
Nia Park: Signed off. Thanks :white_check_mark:
